postconditions.expression: all(S >= sum(w for w, c in zip(*edge) if is_leaf(v, tree)) for tree, S in zip(trees, Ss))
postconditions.description: The sum of weights of paths from the root to each leaf in the final tree is less than or equal to S.

invariants.expression: all(v in tree for tree in trees for v in tree)
invariants.description: Each vertex is in at least one tree.

invariants.expression: all(1 <= v <= n for tree in trees for v in tree)
invariants.description: Each vertex in the tree is between 1 and n inclusive.

invariants.expression: all(1 <= c <= 2 for w, c in zip(*edge) for tree in trees for edge in tree)
invariants.description: The cost of each edge is either 1 or 2.

invariants.expression: all(1 <= w <= 10^6 for w, c in zip(*edge) for tree in trees for edge in tree)
invariants.description: The weight of each edge is between 1 and 10^6 inclusive.

invariants.expression: all(len(tree) == n - 1 for tree in trees)
invariants.description: Each tree description contains n-1 edges.

invariants.expression: all(sum(w for w, c in zip(*edge) if is_leaf(v, tree)) <= S for tree, S in zip(trees, Ss))
invariants.description: The sum of weights of paths from the root to each leaf in each tree is less than or equal to S.
